verses.gurmukhi: ੧੬ : ਦੁਬਾਜਰੋ ਦੀ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਬੀ ਬੁਰੀ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 16 : dhubaajaro dhee ni(n)mrataa bee buree hai

en.bdb: Even the humility of a double talker is evil

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਬਧਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhoojaa bhaau dhubaajaraa badhaa karai salaam na bhaavai|

en.bdb: The double-talker salutes bound by his compulsions, yet his posture is disliked.

verses.gurmukhi: ਢੀਂਗ ਜੁਹਾਰੀ ਢੀਂਗੁਲੀ ਗਲਿ ਬਧੇ ਓਹੁ ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ddee(n)g juhaaree ddee(n)gulee gal badhe oh sees nivaavai|

en.bdb: Dhitighalt, a contraption to draw water from a pit or well comprising a wooden pole, bows only when a stone (as a counterweight) is tied to it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਬਧੈ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਖੂਹਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gal badhai jiau nikalai khoohahu paanee upar aavai|

en.bdb: On the other hand leather bag when tied only, brings out water from the well.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਧਾ ਚਟੀ ਜੋ ਭਰੈ ਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: badhaa chaTee jo bharai naa gun naa upakaar chaRhaavai|

en.bdb: Working under some complusion is neither a merit nor a benevolence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਵੈ ਕਮਾਣ ਦੁਬਾਜਰੀ ਜਿਹ ਫੜਿਦੇ ਇਕ ਸੀਸ ਸਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: nivai kamaan dhubaajaree jeh faRidhe ik sees sahaavai|

en.bdb: The two ended bow with an arrow on it, bends when pulled, but immediately on release, the arrow discharged strikes the head of someone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਵੈ ਅਹੇੜੀ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਸਾਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਸਰੁ ਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: nivai aheRee mirag dhekh karai visaeh dhroh sar laavai|

en.bdb: Similarly, the hunter also bows on the sight of a deer and treacherously kills it with his arrow.
The criminal, thus, goes on committing crimes.
